description: 法式温纳瓦变例 C18 — c5反制时机练习：判断反击的最佳时机

intro.popup_en:
Counterattack the Center, Practice 6
In the French Winawer, Black can challenge the center with ...c5, but timing matters. Identify the best moment for the break and decide whether its positional cost is justified.
intro.popup:
反制中心练习6

法式温纳瓦！

黑方有机会用c5反击
但时机至关重要！

练习目标：
找出c5的最佳时机
判断反击代价是否值得

outro.popup_en: To judge the timing of a counterbreak, ask: are the pieces developed, how far has the opponent's flank attack advanced, and can you maintain your structure after the break? This game contrasts an early ...c5 with a later one.
outro.popup:
温纳瓦总结

时机判断要素：
① 棋子是否都发展好了？
② 对方翼兵攻到哪里了？
③ 反击后能否维持阵形？

这局棋的关键决策点：
早期c5 vs 晚期c5的区别

moves.popup_en: ...c5! Black counterattacks immediately against the base of White's chain.
...Bxc3+ gives up the bishop pair to exchange the knight.
bxc3 recaptures; White has lost the bishop pair.
Bd2 defends against the queen's pressure.
Nh3 develops the knight toward the kingside.
Nf4 places the knight on its intended square.
h4! White launches a kingside pawn attack.
...Nge7 brings the knight back to defend.
g4! White advances again; after g5, the f6-square will be completely closed to Black's knight.
moves.popup:
g4！翼兵继续推进
g5之后完全封锁f6

moves.popup_en: ...Bd7 maneuvers the bishop and prepares queenside castling.
moves.popup:
Bd7 象机动
准备后翼易位

moves.popup_en: Bh3! White places the bishop on a useful diagonal aimed at Black's position.
moves.popup:
Bh3！象就位
对角线瞄准对方阵地

moves.popup_en: ...O-O-O! Black castles long, moving the king to safety behind the queenside pawns.
moves.popup:
O-O-O！后翼易位
黑方王逃入安全堡垒
